records.offer_summary: Starts 11 October 2026; three months; rolling applications opened in September 2026, no exact deadline. Monthly allowance; amount disclosed to shortlisted candidates. Mentorship and practical legal exposure.
responsibilities: Work alongside Riyadh lawyers and business professionals.
Develop professional skills and commercial awareness; practice-group exposure depends on business requirements.
qualifications: Saudi national or long-term resident in Saudi Arabia.
Penultimate year or beyond of a law degree at a recognised Saudi university.
Minimum GPA of 2.5/4.0 or equivalent, achieved or on track.
Submit an up-to-date CV, cover letter and current academic transcript(s).
records.eligibility_summary: Saudi national or long-term resident; penultimate-year law student or beyond at a recognised Saudi university; minimum GPA 2.5/4.0 or equivalent.
records.eligibility_source_text: The programme states Saudi nationality or long-term residence, penultimate-year-or-beyond law study at a recognised Saudi university, and a 2.5/4.0 minimum GPA or equivalent.
